title: Record array build
summary: Proves the compiler's record template: LeanExe.build n g for a record type stores the k component words of g i at words i * k to i * k + k - 1 of a new array, which is flatWords (LeanExe.build n g).
premises: A Flat instance for the element type, with Scalar.values of length k for every element
heap.At for the store and the memory cap
For each index, a Triple for the per-element statement that keeps the store and leaves each element expression yielding its word
result: Heap.NewArray for flatWords (LeanExe.build n g), the owned form of the array of records, with the pointer in the destination local.
